reviewer: architecture + church_functionality + aesthetics (independent specialist, re-review of iter-01 findings)

findings.finding: Status of iter-01 B-ARC-02 (choir): only partly addressed. The chair count is fixed (377) and the chairs now sit on risers, but the choir is still in the far front corners. Its rows run north-south with the tiers rising AWAY from the platform: the +0.80 tier is at x 2.3-9.9 (west) and x 68-78 (east). The highest and most visible choir rows are therefore 17-25 m from the platform band edge (x 27 / 53), with the 80-deg side seating blocks between them and the congregation's view. The two sides are also asymmetric: 15 rows west against 17 rows east, and the east block starts at x 56.8 beside the platform ramp. Choir-to-band and choir-to-conductor contact remains poor, and from the rear (render 04) the choir still reads as a thin purple strip at the far ends.
findings.evidence: model/blender_manifest.json ARC-CHOIR-RISER-W-R01..R15 (x 2.30-15.60, tier 4 +0.80 at R01-R09) and ARC-CHOIR-RISER-E-R01..R17 (x 56.80-77.70, tier 4 at R01-R11); metrics choir_seats 377; params.json stage.rear_band_width 26.0 (band x 27-53); renders/B02-3c1014f7b9/04_interior_from_rear.png; floor_plan.png (B02).
findings.fix: Reverse the tiering so the lowest rows are furthest from the platform, or turn the rows to face the congregation diagonally (about 45 deg) and pull them in towards the platform, so the choir front is within about 12 m of the band. Better, put a 2-3 tier choir loft along the stage wall either side of the band (widen the stage-wall zone to about 36-40 m).

findings.finding: The platform has shrunk instead of growing. Its area fell from 190.3 to 174.6 m2 because the thrust radius went from 5.5 to 4.5 m, while the rear band is still 26 x 5.5 m. That is undersized for a band, drum riser, monitors and a platform party of 60, and it reads small against the 80 m stage wall. The iter-01 B-ARC-06 recommendation (7-8 m deep, about 34 m wide) was not taken up.
findings.evidence: comparison.md platform area 174.6 m2 (A 200.0); space_schedule.csv SP-02 174.65 m2; params.json stage.rear_band_width 26.0, rear_band_depth 5.5, thrust_radius 4.5; metrics egress.platform 60.
findings.fix: Deepen the rear band to 7-8 m by moving the stage wall north into the back-of-house corridor zone (the 3 m corridor can shift), and widen it to about 34 m. That would give at least 230 m2 including the thrust.

findings.finding: Status of iter-01 B-ARC-03 (ministry floor): partly addressed. Row 1 now starts 9.3 m from the focus, leaving a ring about 4.8 m deep in front of the 4.5 m thrust (about 90 m2 over the central fan). However, it is not modelled as a named space and is not physically separated from the front cross passage. The basis-of-design claim 'separate from the front cross passage' therefore cannot be verified in the model. Row 1 holds only 10 seats.
findings.evidence: reports/seating_schedule.csv min radius_from_focus 9.3 m, row 1 = 10 seats; metrics.sightline_model F [40.0, 45.75], thrust_radius 4.5; space_schedule.csv has no ministry / altar-call space; params.json seating._iteration2.
findings.fix: Model the ministry floor as its own IfcSpace (e.g. SP-02M 'Ministry / altar-call floor'). Define the front cross passage as a separate marked 1.8-2.4 m strip outside it, and show the egress assignment so it does not depend on that floor.

findings.finding: Status of iter-01 B-ARC-01 (side-on preaching): improved but not resolved, and paid for with distance. Narrowing the fan from 85 to 80 deg cut side-on seats (more than 75 deg) from 320 to 228, but added a row (31 to 32) and deepened the hall to 51.55 m. Mean pulpit distance rose from 27.32 to 28.65 m and max from 39.48 to 40.17 m; seats within 30 m fell from 53.4% to 47.6%, and 1,572 seats now rely on screens (was 1,398).
findings.evidence: comparison.md (B02): max bearing 80.0 deg, 228 seats > 75 deg, rows 32, pulpit mean 28.65 / max 40.17 m, within 30 m 0.476; iter-01 comparison: 85.0 deg, 320, 31 rows, 27.32 / 39.48 m, 0.534; metrics hall_depth_grid_2_4 51.55, offaxis_pulpit.relying_on_screens 1572.
findings.fix: Rather than narrowing the fan further, wrap the outer side blocks around the thrust: rotate the outermost blocks' focus a few metres forward onto the pulpit (a second focus for the side wedges), or step the thrust 2 m further into the room. This keeps distance down and turns the side blocks towards the preacher.

findings.finding: Status of iter-01 B-ARC-05 (booth): not addressed. The booth is unchanged at x 43.3 (3.3 m off axis) and 24.4 m2. Its floor at +3.52 is only 0.195 m above the rear passage (L02 +3.325), so people standing in the passage will block the mix position's view and sound.
findings.evidence: manifest ARC-BOOTH matrix x 43.30, y -2.70, z 3.52; levels L02 +3.325; space_schedule.csv SP-08 24.36 m2; open_issues.md 'Booth sits 0.4-6.2 m east of the centre line'.
findings.fix: Shift the truss setting-out half a bay so a bay falls on x = 40 and centre the booth there. Raise its floor at least 0.9-1.0 m above the rear passage, or add a front-of-house mix position in the cross aisle on the axis, and enlarge it to about 40 m2.

findings.finding: Status of iter-01 B-ARC-04 (entrance sequence): partly addressed, with a new regression. The foyer is now 12 m deep and 1,039 m2, and the stairs are split into flights of at most 12 risers with landings. But the rear passage rose from +2.98 to +3.325, so every arrival climbs about 19-20 risers before walking down into the hall. The rear-corner side foyers are still residual triangles (233 m2 each) holding the toilets. The footprint grew to 7,165 m2, 31% more than A's 5,473 m2 for the same 3,000 seats.
findings.evidence: space_schedule.csv SP-06 Main foyer 1038.96 m2, SP-05W/E (floor_plan B02: 233 m2); levels L02 +3.325 (iter-01 +2.980); comparison.md footprint 7165.0 m2 vs 5473.4, stairs / risers 9 / 128; params.json foyer._iteration2.
findings.fix: Lower the whole bowl by about 1.0-1.5 m (sink the front rows and platform below foyer grade, with the platform still step-free from the back of house). Arrivals then climb at most 1.5-2 m, or enter level, and the booth gains height over the passage. Give the side foyers daylight and a direct opening from the main foyer.

findings.finding: Status of iter-01 B-ARC-07 (massing): not addressed. It is still a single mono-pitch plane, now 92 x 78 m, with the low eave and a flat canopy facing the entrance. Glazing is unchanged at 94.3 m2, and there is no identity element. The exterior reads as a warehouse.
findings.evidence: renders/B02-3c1014f7b9/01_exterior_aerial.png; comparison.md roof area 6,705 m2, roof top 14.32 m, glazing 94.3 m2.
findings.fix: Raise an entrance volume or clerestory lantern over the foyer stairs, or reverse the pitch so the tall face addresses the arrival side. Fully glaze the foyer facade under a deep overhang, and add a cross, tower or perforated identity screen.

findings.finding: The interior is unchanged in character: exposed X-bracing either side of the platform on the stage wall, a blank 80 m stage elevation, and no stage-wall feature.
findings.fix: Move the stage-wall bracing to the end bays or behind a lining, and model a stage-wall feature and acoustic treatment.

findings.finding: The reports are out of step with the model: open_issues.md still says 'Side seats reach 85 deg bearing from the pulpit: preaching to a 170 deg fan', but the B02 model measures 80.0 deg (a 160 deg fan). The stage _proposal text in params.json also still says thrust radius 5.5 m.
findings.evidence: reports/open_issues.md (B02) vs metrics.offaxis_pulpit.max_bearing_from_pulpit_deg 80.0; params.json stage._proposal 'radius 5.5 m' vs stage.thrust_radius 4.5.
findings.fix: Regenerate the open-issue text from the metrics, not fixed strings, and update the proposal notes.

strengths: Verified fixes: a ground-floor lift door now exists (DR-LIFT-L00 at x 57.8, y -3.08, with DR-LIFT-L02 above), and the front wheelchair places sit in rows 1-2 of the centre blocks near the axis (params accessibility._iteration2).
Choir capacity is restored to 377 chairs (A: 386) on 0.2 m risers up to +0.80 (ARC-CHOIR-RISER-*).
Fewer side-on seats: 228 seats > 75 deg (was 320), max head turn 14.7 deg, 0 seats > 30 deg (comparison.md).
Still much closer than A: mean pulpit distance 28.65 m against 35.52 m, max 40.17 m against 57.58 m, no seat beyond about 40 m.
A larger main foyer (1,039 m2) with stairs in flights of at most 12 risers and landings, and an about 4.8 m ministry ring in front of the thrust.
Dedicated back-of-house exit passages (SP-BOH-X-W/E) now link the stage-side exits to final exits.
limitations: Scores cover only architecture (15%), church_functionality (15%) and aesthetics (5%). weighted_score = 2.18 is the partial contribution of these three disciplines (35% of total weight); normalised to 0-10 it is 6.2. I verified the changes against model/blender_manifest.json (B02), params.json, the schedules, floor_plan.png, the regenerated comparison.md and the B02 renders. I did not open the .blend or IFC. I did not check choir-to-conductor or booth sightlines geometrically, and the ministry-floor area is my estimate from seat radii, not a modelled space. No site data were available.
certification_disclaimer: This review is a structured concept-stage QA opinion from an AI reviewer. It is not professional architectural certification, code-compliance verification, fire or accessibility approval, or engineering sign-off. All dimensions in the model are unverified pending review by registered Zimbabwean professionals and the authorities.
